title: The rare-atom face has an explicit uniform collar

composition.ou_monotonicity: Rademacher relative Fisher is nondecreasing in the signal parameter t under reverse OU time.
composition.stability_input: K1757 gives loss at most 400000 sqrt(2z) outside the K1758 zero-noise collar.

coverage.inside_zero_noise: covered for every z by K1758
coverage.joint_corner: covered by K1758 without using the rare-face stability estimate

scope_guard: The explicit collar is deliberately conservative and extremely thin. It proves absence of a boundary escape but is not a practical compact-core subdivision scale or a whole-chart optimizer theorem.
